newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News Ltd announces management changes.
newsitem.headline: News Ltd announces management changes.

text.p: News Ltd, the Australian arm of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, said on Wednesday it has made three management changes, effective immediately.

News Ltd said Malcolm Noad would be appointed group general manager, newpapers. Noad is presently managaing director of Mirror Australian Telegraph Newspapers (MATP), News Ltd's Sydney-based newspaper division.
It said all News Ltd groups newspaper directors and group newspaper executives would report to Noad.
Jerry Harris would becomes managing director of MATP, Harris had been MATP group advertising manager since 1994.
News Ltd said John Hartigan editor-in-chief of The Daily Telegraph and The Sunday Telegraph, to the newly-created position of group editorial director.
Executive chairman Lachlan Murdoch said Hartigan retains responsibility for the two newspapers and The Sportsman.
Murdoch said all News Ltd bureaus would now report to Hartigan as well.
Hartigan would report directly to Lachlan Murdoch.
